title: [GMCP 203.041.M] Mastery: Reliability, durability, recovery, backup, and offline operation
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-041-M. Pass the complete vector mastery target on the shipped production path: Crash-consistent journals and atomic state transitions recover tasks, approvals, registry snapshots, desired state and lifecycle operations without replaying side effects. Defined RPO/RTO targets are met under kill -9, power-loss simulation, corrupt/torn state, full disk and clock skew; backups are encrypted, versioned and restore-tested; and all declared local capabilities remain usable without network access. Consume and verify the evidence produced by requirements 01-06; reject missing, stale, unsigned, locally modified, waived, mock-only, or zero-test evidence. Task closure and roadmap prose are not proof.
